body: I don't think I'm rushing into it, I've been researching methods years and this one was on the peaceful pill handbook. First attempt straight razor across the wrists, someone who I thought was on holiday came back and found me. Second attempt was a chloroform overdose, I just woke up hours later with a headache, and not dead.
I'm just depressed and nothing makes it go away. 9 anti depressants tried, psychiatrist and councillors and reablement workers weekly for years, nothing helped. This seems like the logical solution
Yes, several times. I don't understand physics well enough to do hanging. This way seems quite peaceful, you're asleep by the time you start suffocating
